payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Master Shell & Modular Blade Partials (M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001)
payload.objective: Implement the R21 Major Project frontend workspace shell and modular Blade partial structure, replacing the 2,611-line legacy monolithic view with a maintainable CampusLynk workspace composed entirely from the existing layout and UI component system.
payload.explicit_request: Review the implementation TASK_REPORT for task 'M2.2-IMPLEMENT-001' (Slice 1: Master Shell & Modular Blade Partials Structure). Confirm whether Slice 1 is approved and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 2 (M2.2-IMPLEMENT-002: Modals, Interactivity & AJAX Bindings). Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

task_report.summary: Slice 1 completed. 9 modular Blade files created replacing the 2,611-line legacy monolith with 1,045 lines (max file 185 lines). Uses <x-layouts.workspace-layout> and 100% <x-ui.*> components. All 7 tabs structurally present. Modals and JavaScript deferred to Slice 2. All 9 files pass PHP syntax check. User.php and M2.1 backend untouched.

tests.syntax: php -l on all 9 Blade files -> PASS (0 errors)
tests.models_unit: php artisan test --filter=R21MajorProjectModelsTest -> PASS (5 tests, 61 assertions)
tests.audit_unit: php artisan test --filter=AuditLogTest -> PASS (6 tests, 17 assertions)
tests.controller_feature: 10/11 passed; show() endpoint returned HTML view (HTTP 200) causing assertJson failure. Controller needs wantsJson check in Slice 2.

issues: R21VirtualClassroomMajorProjectController::show() checks view()->exists() before request()->wantsJson(). When getJson() is called in tests, HTML is returned instead of JSON. Whitelist expansion to include controller and feature test recommended for Slice 2.

payload.reason: Slice 1 satisfies its structural and design-system objectives: the 2,611-line legacy workspace has been decomposed into nine modular Blade files, the largest is 185 lines, the root uses x-layouts.workspace-layout, and the reported UI elements use the existing x-ui.* component system without duplicate CSS or raw tables. The single feature-test failure is a real integration issue exposed by the newly created view: R21VirtualClassroomMajorProjectController::show() currently selects the rendered Blade view before honoring a JSON request, causing getJson() to receive HTML. Slice 1 correctly did not modify the controller because it was outside the approved whitelist. Therefore the issue is not a reason to roll back the completed UI decomposition; it should be repaired as part of Slice 2, with the controller and dedicated workspace feature test explicitly added to the Slice 2 whitelist. Slice 2 is authorized to implement the six x-ui.modal workflows, client-side calculations/AJAX bindings, and the minimal controller response-negotiation correction required to restore the existing M2.1 test contract. The Slice 2 implementation must preserve the established workspace shell and component architecture and must not introduce duplicate UI infrastructure.

task_dispatch.objective: Complete the R21 Major Project workspace interactivity by implementing the six standardized x-ui.modal workflows, restoring the legacy client-side calculations and AJAX bindings against the M2.1 backend contract, and applying the minimal controller response-negotiation fix required for JSON feature-test compatibility.
instructions: Inspect the completed Slice 1 Blade structure and the legacy virtual_classroom_project.blade.php before implementation. Preserve the modular decomposition; do not reconstruct the legacy monolith.

Create resources/views/r21_project/partials/modals.blade.php containing the six required modal workflows: ciaEvalModal, groupCiaModal, evalModal, groupEseModal, examinersModal, and modalDeleteGroupConfirm.
Implement every modal using the existing <x-ui.modal> component. Do not create inline modal backdrops, custom dialog markup, duplicate modal CSS, or a second modal framework.

Create resources/views/r21_project/partials/scripts.blade.php containing the client-side behavior required by the workspace, including the legacy calculation routines and AJAX/fetch handlers needed for evaluation, groups, examiners, attainment, and related workspace operations.
Reconcile every AJAX request against the completed M2.1 routes before wiring it. Do not invent endpoints or silently call legacy controller routes that have already been replaced.

Preserve the seven-tab workspace structure and existing component usage from Slice 1. Do not replace x-ui.table, x-ui.button, x-ui.card, x-ui.badge, x-ui.tabs, x-ui.input, x-ui.select, or x-ui.icon with raw equivalents.

Modify R21VirtualClassroomMajorProjectController.php only to correct request negotiation in show(): JSON requests must receive the expected JSON response before the view-existence/rendering branch, while normal browser requests must continue rendering the new workspace view.

Create tests/Feature/R21MajorProjectWorkspaceViewTest.php to verify the new workspace view renders through the workspace layout, the expected structural partials/components are present, and the relevant JSON/view response behavior remains correct.

Update the existing R21MajorProjectControllerTest only if required to accurately verify the minimal show() response-negotiation fix; do not weaken or remove the existing assertion that exposed the regression.

Use the existing M2.1 controller contract as the backend source of truth. Do not modify AttainmentService, models, migrations, or routes unless a genuine blocking discrepancy is discovered; if one is discovered, stop and report it rather than expanding scope.

Run the dedicated workspace test, the existing R21MajorProjectControllerTest, R21MajorProjectModelsTest, the full application test suite, and PHP syntax checks on every modified/created PHP/Blade file.
Verify the final working-tree diff against the exact Slice 2 whitelist before reporting completion.
Return a TASK_REPORT only. Do not commit changes; checkpoint and commit authorization will be handled separately by the architect.
constraints: Allowed files for this slice are exactly: carmel-linx-laravel/resources/views/r21_project/partials/modals.blade.php, carmel-linx-laravel/resources/views/r21_project/partials/scripts.blade.php, carmel-linx-laravel/app/Http/Controllers/R21VirtualClassroomMajorProjectController.php, carmel-linx-laravel/tests/Feature/R21MajorProjectWorkspaceViewTest.php, and, only if necessary, carmel-linx-laravel/tests/Feature/R21MajorProjectControllerTest.php.
Do not modify migrations, models, AttainmentService, routes, database state, or migration control-plane files.
Do not create additional global UI components.
All interactive controls MUST reuse existing x-ui.* components.
No raw HTML tables, custom modal implementations, duplicate button styles, duplicate CSS, or inline component substitutes.
Do not exceed the established 500-line per-Blade-file ceiling.
Do not alter the approved Slice 1 decomposition except where an explicit integration requirement makes a minimal change necessary.
Do not expand scope into M2.3 print-report implementation.
task_dispatch.expected_report: Return TASK_REPORT containing: exact files created/modified; modal inventory and x-ui.modal mapping; JavaScript/AJAX functions implemented and their corresponding M2.1 endpoints; explanation of the show() JSON/view response fix; dedicated workspace test results; existing controller/model test results; full-suite results; PHP/Blade syntax results; line counts; confirmation of design-system and anti-duplication compliance; exact whitelist verification; confirmation that User.php, migrations, database, routes, and M2.1 service/model artifacts were untouched; any issues or deviations; and whether M2.2 is ready for final checkpoint verification.
stop_conditions: Stop if any required change falls outside the authorized Slice 2 whitelist; report the blocker instead.
Stop if an existing x-ui.* component cannot support a required interaction and a new global component would be needed; report the component gap instead of creating a duplicate.
Stop if a backend endpoint required by the legacy behavior is absent from the M2.1 contract; report it rather than inventing or expanding the backend.
Do not modify database state or execute migrations.
Do not modify migration control-plane state.
